description: An ARQ U_PDU makes the SIS ask for a soft link; the CAS calls the peer with an Ed4 PHYSICAL LINK REQUEST, the peer accepts, the link is made and the held U_PDU goes down to the DTS.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 5 for ARQ (service type tx_mode 1, delivery confirmation none) and gets S_BIND_ACCEPTED with MTU 2048 (A-0041, A-0047). At 0 it sends an S_UNIDATA_REQUEST (priority 0, SAP 9 at 0.0.1.3, DELIVERY MODE default, TTL 0, so TTD = 1296000000 ms, U_PDU "ping"). ARQ data needs a soft link first, so the SIS holds the U_PDU and asks the CAS for a physical link (A-0008, A-0188, A-0193). The CAS starts the Caller procedure (B-0196, B-0202): link_state calling, and a PHYSICAL LINK REQUEST with Ed4 set, since the peer's edition is unknown (B-0124, B-0408), Short clear (B-0409) and LINK clear (B-0127), octet 12, handed to the DTS for a type 8 D_PDU (B-0129). Contention: LBT 30000 (K-0070), slot 15, 45000 ms; at 75000 the request goes out. Its transmission ends at 80550, and only then does cas.link_request/0.0.1.3 start, with cas.link_request_timeout_ms (B-0203, B-0204, B-0400, C-1100). At 91000, from 0.0.1.3, a type 8 D_PDU carrying PHYSICAL LINK ACCEPTED with Ed4 set and Short clear (octet 22). The Caller stops its timer and declares the link made (B-0219): link_state linked, the peer recorded Ed4 (B-0227, B-0408) and the 16-bit FSN family in force (B-0142, B-0232), D_CONNECTION_MADE to the DTS (C-0571) before C_PHYSICAL_LINK_MADE to the SIS, which declares the soft link established (A-0194) and passes the held U_PDU to the CAS and the DTS as ARQ data (A-0188). The DTS keeps dts.ttd at that C_PDU's TTD, 1296000000 - 91000 ms (C-1050). What is sent on the link is P4-2's; the scenario ends here, during the peer's burst. Fixture: preamble 600, flush 150, 25 bytes and 4800 ms a block, so one type 8 D_PDU carrying a one-byte C_PDU (address size 3, C-0133) fills a block exactly and a one-block transmission lasts 5550 ms, EOT and reception window ceil(4950 / 500) = 10 (C-0104, C-1043, C-0350). Every C_PDU of this scenario is a one-octet CAS-1 C_PDU sent once in a type 8 D_PDU (B-0129, B-0143, B-0152, B-0191), C_PDU IDs from 0 (C-1040), EOW 0. Seed 0 draws uniform(16) = 15 then 4: contention waits 45000 then 12000 ms (K-0080). Settings: cas.max_links, cas.link_request_timeout_ms 60000, cas.link_request_retries and cas.first_data_timeout_ms 120000.  The SIS soft link times are unset, so they are derived: sis.soft_link_idle and sis.soft_link_min_hold (called node only) three answer waits, sis.soft_link_max six; none falls due within the run, and the idle wait stops while an ARQ U_PDU is outstanding (A-0320, A-0321, A-0326).
